# `tests/test_invariants.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › `test_invariants.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Tests invariants that define core system design properties rather than individual features. Each test asserts a design constraint that must hold for the system to function correctly, from the verify lane's isolation from implementation details to append-only evidence recording to traceability mechanisms.

2,303 lines, a test.
